title: Product singular no-cache root cause isolated by reversible A-B-A

esi_saved_retest.result: reviews/comments-open product stayed no-cache,esi=on; ESI did not fix caching

cookie_ab.conclusion: woocommerce_recently_viewed and initial d_user_session are not the root cause

reviews_disabled_ab.conclusion: product singular becomes publicly cacheable when reviews are disabled

rollback.conclusion: rollback restored both review state and original no-cache behavior; no stale reviews-disabled public cache remained

root_cause_scope.proven: The no-cache trigger is causally coupled to the open product review/comment path.
excluded: VPI/lazy-loading configuration as a cache cause
LiteSpeed ESI enablement as a fix
woocommerce_recently_viewed cookie as the root cause
initial d_user_session cookie as the root cause
WooCommerce core cart/checkout/account cache helper as the product singular cause
root_cause_scope.unresolved_exact_owner: Exact hook inside the review/comment renderer remains opaque; current evidence points to the IranKala/protected renderer-runtime comments path or another hook executed only when comments/reviews are open.

decision.safest_next_action: Keep reviews enabled. Escalate/fix the IranKala vendor-supported comments/review renderer so open reviews do not call LiteSpeed no-cache, then rerun the same product acceptance matrix.
acceptance: reviews_allowed remains true and review form/reviews remain usable
anonymous product request is cacheable and reaches HIT on repeated request
cart, checkout and account remain private/non-cacheable
no VPI or lazy-loading experiment is repeated
no_repeat: global or persistent disabling of product reviews
